name: Cyient Ltd
title: Cyient Ltd - 532175 - Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Earnings Call Transcript

read.thesis: DET Q4 revenue fell 2.4% QoQ in constant currency to $163.5M with normalised EBIT 12.4%; management reiterates FY27 mid-to-high single digit growth and 15% EBIT exit, but Strategic Units fell 12.4% QoQ and no capacity signals were given.

triggers.label: Strategic Units down 12.4% QoQ
triggers.quote: Our strategic units indicate a degrowth of 12.4% quarter-over-quarter and a full year degrowth of 12.2% year-over-year.

triggers.label: Q4 DET revenue -2.4% QoQ cc
triggers.quote: leading to a degrowth of 2.4% quarter -over-quarter in const ant currency

triggers.label: Some customers accepted price increases
triggers.quote: Some of our existing customers have also backed us on price increases this year.

triggers.label: Q1 FY27 Strategic Units to flat
triggers.quote: we definitely would want to bring it back to as close as flat for next quarter.

guidance.quote: we are aspiring for mid - to high single -digit organic growth year -over-year
we will try and get there by Q4 of FY27
we will get to a $100 million kind of a number for this year

guidance.value: 40% to 50% of earnings via dividend plus buyback
guidance.quote: the Board has asked us to continue to stick with the 40% to 50% pay out

prior_guidance_check.metric: FY27 EBIT margin 15% by Q4 FY27

red_flags.label: Deal slippage and budget delays
red_flags.quote: a shift in some clients' budget deployments created a downward variance against the visibility we had set

red_flags.label: Project Astro diligence charge INR71 crore
red_flags.quote: an exceptional charge of INR71 crores of due diligence expenses tied to a large M&A transaction

red_flags.label: Semiconductor equity raise and losses
red_flags.quote: the Board has agreed in principle to explore a fundraise in the market in a combination of debt and equity

evasions.quote: It wouldn't be fair with all the NDAs in place to talk about any specifics
that's for our investors to determine
